step2.ptxt: Turn the ignition ON, select "Diagnosis" → "Chassis" → "Electric Power Steering" → "Special Control History" on the SST (TaSCAN) display screen, and check the history.

entry.ptxt: Indicates whether there is overheat prevention control history
PIG Power Supply Voltage Drop History
Indicates whether there is PIG power supply voltage drop history
Indicates whether there is engine speed signal interruption history
Steering Angle Sensor Signal Loss History
Indicates whether there is steering angle sensor signal interruption history
Indicates whether there is vehicle speed signal invalid history
Indicates number of battery voltage drop history occurrences

item.ptxt: If the steering wheel is turned repeatedly while the vehicle is stopped or driven at low speed, or if the steering wheel is held fully turned for a long time, the power assist may be reduced to prevent the motor and computer from overheating. In this case, the system returns to normal if the steering wheel is not operated for approximately 10 minutes with the engine idling.

If the battery is insufficiently charged or the voltage drops temporarily, the power assist may be reduced or the P/S warning light may come on. In this case, the system returns to normal when the battery voltage recovers.
If "Battery Voltage Drop History" displays a value other than "0", inspect the charging system. (For the procedure, refer to [2AZ-FE models] or [2GR-FE models])
